title: Entropy and Deligne periods
statement: Let $\log_p:\mathbb{C}_p^*\to\mathbb{C}_p$ be the branch of the $p$-adic logarithm with $\log_p(p)=0$, and let $T_\lambda:x\mapsto\lambda x$ on $\mathbb{Q}_p$. Is there a meaningful entropy-like invariant $h_p$, for example invariant under topological conjugacy, such that $h_p(T_\lambda)=\log_p\lambda$?

research_summary: Partial progress. Substantial $p$-adic dynamics literature exists, but the proposed entropy-like invariant $h_p$ with $h_p(T_\lambda)=\log_p\lambda$, invariant under topological conjugacy and connected to Deligne/p-adic periods, is not established. The "entropy" of $p$-adic multiplication maps in the Langlands/period sense is still being formulated.
